caelestia-board: #251 Follow Caelestia: new states for the scheme on top of the Default dark theme. The base takes only the scheme's board, panel, dot and accent colours; this also takes its text, second surface, focus colour and card colours, kept to the theme's contrast, and says which theme it sits on.
